notes: These percentages describe acceptance-criterion coverage only. They are unrelated to browser code coverage in reports/coverage/, which measures which application JavaScript executed and is never evidence that an acceptance criterion is satisfied.
The denominator is the seven ACs APPROVED at Gate 1, not the ten the story proposed. AC-ETA-411-002, AC-ETA-411-008 and AC-ETA-411-010 were DEFERRED by the reviewer and are open work, not coverage.

AC-ETA-411-006 is counted as passed but is NOT settled. TS-ETA-411-005 proves the Organization entry opens the organization administration settings; it cannot prove Organization is a destination distinct from Preferences, because the two share an address and the same seven visible headings. See reports/validation/TP-ETA-411-001-expectation-mismatch.json. A reviewer decision is outstanding.

AC-ETA-411-009 is counted as passed on the presence of an error message, not its wording. The application tells a never-signed-in visitor that their session timed out, which remains an open observation.

AC-ETA-411-009 FAILED in EXEC-ETA-411-002 on 2026-09-07 and is reported as DEF-ETA-411-001 / ETA-417. It PASSED in EXEC-ETA-411-001 on 2026-09-05 against the same commit and environment, so the failure is intermittent. A filed bug does not make a failed criterion covered: passCoveragePct is 85.71, not 100.

Only half of AC-ETA-411-009 is failing. The visitor is still refused and kept on the sign-in page; the missing part is the error message. The criterion is counted as failed because it is stated as a single criterion, not because access control regressed.

TS-ETA-411-002 (AC-ETA-411-003) failed in a two-worker run on 2026-09-07 and passed with --workers=1, so EXEC-ETA-411-002 records it as PASSED. It is NOT counted as a failure and NOT raised as a defect, because a failure that disappears under serialisation is not yet evidence about the application. It remains an open concurrency question.
REQ-ETA-411-006 was DEFERRED in full and carries no approved acceptance criterion, so it appears nowhere in this matrix. Its coverage is unknown, not zero and not complete.
